# `get_img_file_in_jpg`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

File channel: read a stored image/AVI frame from disk and return it as JPEG.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (thumbnail cache write for FITS; 64-bit build, 32-bit build has the same call structure (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager file table (serves 4801), handler @0x1f6880 (64-bit build), @0x183860 (32-bit build); static analysis of app 3.3.2, RemoteBigPhotoEntity / AlbumBigCellBean command builders; FillPath, Fit2Jpg (FITS), AviFrame2Jpg (one AVI frame), request-local IMG_DATA, reponse_result; jrpc_error with err_code/get_err_string on path errors; Fit2Jpg passes the GetThumbnailName result (suffix _thn, extension .jpg) to IMG_DATA::ToJPG, which calls CanAccess and, when the file is absent, cv::imwrite of a scaled image (GetThumbRatio, 200); AviFrame2Jpg passes an empty path (no write) |

File-channel (4801) method. Resolves `name` to a path under the image store, reads the stored file and converts it to JPEG in a request-local buffer: a FITS file is converted whole and an AVI file gives one frame; any other file type gives error 102 (`invalid params`). The reply is JPEG (imgType 4). A missing or invalid path gives a text error carrying the current error code. READ. For a FITS file it also creates a thumbnail JPEG beside the file when none exists, a persistent cache write, so it is a MUTATOR with observation-safe (tier B) effects. The 32-bit build matches (READ), apart from log wording and image-library version.

Side effects: Resolves a request path and reads a stored file from disk, converting it (or one AVI frame) to JPEG in a request-local buffer, then responds. READ; the 32-bit build matches (READ). For a FITS file the conversion is also given a thumbnail path: the file name with a `_thn` suffix and a `.jpg` extension, in the same folder. If no file exists at that path, a reduced-size JPEG thumbnail is written there and kept. READ (64-bit build; the 32-bit build has the same call structure, READ). Repeating the call does not rewrite an existing thumbnail. The AVI-frame conversion is given no path and writes nothing. READ.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_img_file_in_jpg"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | no | - | Object form sent by the app. Device-side parsing is unresolved. [READ] |
| `params.name` | string | yes | - | Remote file path, as listed by get_albums (INFERRED source). [READ] |

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":1,"method":"get_img_file_in_jpg","params":{"name":"MyWorks/example.jpg"}}
```
